instruction: Design a system that combines the 4-bit ripple carry adder and the 4-bit shift-left register with parallel load and asynchronous reset. The system should take two 4-bit inputs and perform addition with carry using the ripple carry adder. The output from the adder should be loaded into the shift-left register with parallel load when the load input is high. The shift input should be used to shift the register left on the rising edge of the clock signal. The register should reset to zero on the rising edge of the reset signal. The system should include an additional functional module that takes in both the sum output from the ripple carry adder and the output from the shift-left register to obtain a final output.
